basics.name: Jahaan Suthar
basics.label: iOS Developer
basics.headline: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering · VIT Chennai
basics.summary: Driven Computer Science student and highly adaptive iOS Developer specializing in engineering performant, highly responsive native applications using Swift and SwiftUI. Combines strong foundational knowledge of Data Structures and MVVM architecture with cutting-edge, AI-assisted development workflows to accelerate time-to-market. Recognized as a high-velocity learner capable of breaking down, mastering, and applying complex new frameworks or production systems within 24-hour cycles to transform abstract concepts into production-ready software solutions.

work.name: Wipro × InspireLeap

Collaborated on algorithmic problem-solving paradigms to systematically optimize core data structures.

projects.name: CampusConnect
projects.description: Campus networking and utility web app for university student collaboration.

Built a highly interactive front-end interface focused on fluid layout components, real-time update structures, and asset routing.
Structured scalable client-side navigation paths ensuring smooth resource discoverability and data parsing transitions.

projects.name: bizflow
projects.description: Business productivity and workflow visualization tracker.

Implemented dynamic data tracking pipelines to parse structural project metrics and handle concurrent process states natively.

projects.name: Quote_Generator_IOS
projects.description: Native SwiftUI quote generator built on MVVM.
